name: Adaptive-FAM
definition: A functional approximation multi-resolution representation that uses adaptive encoding to dynamically compress micro-blocks based on their content, designed for out-of-core interactive visualization of large-scale volumetric datasets.
summary: Adaptive-FAM is a multi-resolution encoding pipeline that uses spatial partitioning and adaptive polynomial approximation to minimize model size and reduce I/O latency for out-of-core volume rendering.
